---------------------------- MODULE W4Od5m5p1t4 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

Voters == {"v1", "v2", "v3"}
Ids    == {"p1", "p2"}
Quorum == 2
MaxCap == 3

VARIABLES version, log, pending, capacity, usedIds
vars == <<version, log, pending, capacity, usedIds>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ version \in 0..2
    /\ pending \subseteq [id: Ids, base: 0..2, votes: SUBSET Voters]
    /\ capacity \in 1..MaxCap
    /\ usedIds \subseteq Ids

Init ==
    /\ version = 0
    /\ log = << >>
    /\ pending = {}
    /\ capacity = 1
    /\ usedIds = {}

Propose(id) ==
    /\ id \notin usedIds
    /\ pending' = pending \cup {[id |-> id, base |-> version, votes |-> {}]}
    /\ usedIds' = usedIds \cup {id}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, log, capacity>>

Vote(v, p) ==
    /\ p \in pending
    /\ v \notin p.votes
    /\ pending' = (pending \ {p}) \cup {[id |-> p.id, base |-> p.base, votes |-> p.votes \cup {v}]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, log, capacity, usedIds>>

Commit(p) ==
    /\ p \in pending
    /\ Cardinality(p.votes) >= Quorum
    /\ p.base = version
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ log' = Append(log, [id |-> p.id, base |-> p.base])
    /\ pending' = pending \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<capacity, usedIds>>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ \E c \in 1..MaxCap : capacity' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, log, pending, usedIds>>

Next ==
    \/ \E id \in Ids : Propose(id)
    \/ \E v \in Voters, p \in pending : Vote(v, p)
    \/ \E p \in pending : Commit(p)
    \/ Reconfigure

NoLostUpdate == \A i \in 1..Len(log) : log[i].base = i - 1

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby uses a small cluster of coordinator nodes to manage one shared roster record. Any coordinator may propose a change to the roster, and each proposal records the roster version it was based on when it was read. A proposal is only applied after a quorum of the coordinators votes to approve it, and even then only if the roster version has not moved since the proposal was read. When a proposal commits, the roster version advances by one and the change is appended to the committed log. The lobby capacity can change at runtime as the operator scales the match size up or down, independently of the voting. The danger is a lost update: two coordinators read the same version, both get approved, and the second silently overwrites the first, erasing a committed change. The model tracks the version counter, the committed log, the set of pending proposals with their votes, the runtime capacity, and which proposal ids have been used.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every committed update to the shared roster was based on the version immediately preceding it, so no committed update is ever overwritten or lost.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od11m5p0t5 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

Jobs   == {"j1", "j2", "j3"}
Voters == {"s1", "s2", "s3"}
Quorum == 2

VARIABLES state, votes, overrides, doneLog
vars == <<state, votes, overrides, doneLog>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ state \in [Jobs -> {"queued", "printing", "done"}]
    /\ votes \in [Jobs -> SUBSET Voters]
    /\ overrides \in 0..3
    /\ doneLog \in Seq(Jobs)

Init ==
    /\ state = [j \in Jobs |-> "queued"]
    /\ votes = [j \in Jobs |-> {}]
    /\ overrides = 0
    /\ doneLog = << >>

NonedPrinting == \A j \in Jobs : state[j] # "printing"

CastVote(v, j) ==
    /\ state[j] = "queued"
    /\ v \notin votes[j]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![j] = votes[j] \cup {v}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<state, overrides, doneLog>>

Grant(j) ==
    /\ state[j] = "queued"
    /\ Cardinality(votes[j]) >= Quorum
    /\ NonedPrinting
    /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![j] = "printing"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, overrides, doneLog>>

AdminGrant(j) ==
    /\ state[j] = "queued"
    /\ NonedPrinting
    /\ overrides < 3
    /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![j] = "printing"]
    /\ overrides' = overrides + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, doneLog>>

Finish(j) ==
    /\ state[j] = "printing"
    /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![j] = "done"]
    /\ doneLog' = Append(doneLog, j)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, overrides>>

Next ==
    \/ \E v \in Voters, j \in Jobs : CastVote(v, j)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : Grant(j)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : AdminGrant(j)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : Finish(j)

PrinterMutualExclusion ==
    \A a, b \in Jobs :
        (state[a] = "printing" /\ state[b] = "printing") => a = b

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT PrinterMutualExclusion
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
A print shop runs one high-end printer that jobs must take turns using. A cluster of spooler nodes votes on which queued job gets the printer next, and a job is only granted the printer once a quorum of spoolers approves it. Because only one physical printer exists, the granting rule also insists that no other job currently holds it, so grants are mutually exclusive. A privileged shop administrator can override the vote and hand the printer directly to a queued job, but even the override refuses to act while another job is printing. Once a job finishes printing it releases the printer and is logged as done. The hazard is two jobs believing they simultaneously own the single printer, which would garble output. The model tracks each job's state, the votes gathered per job, how many admin overrides were used, and the finished-job log.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At no reachable state are two different jobs simultaneously in the printing state on the single shared printer.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od8m3p0t4 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

Nodes   == {"n1", "n2", "n3"}
MaxTerm == 3
MaxSeat == 4

VARIABLES role, term, seats, enrolled
vars == <<role, term, seats, enrolled>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ role \in [Nodes -> {"follower", "leader", "crashed"}]
    /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
    /\ seats \in 0..MaxSeat
    /\ enrolled \in 0..MaxSeat

Init ==
    /\ role = [n \in Nodes |-> "follower"]
    /\ term = 0
    /\ seats = 2
    /\ enrolled = 0

NoLeader == \A n \in Nodes : role[n] # "leader"

Elect(n) ==
    /\ role[n] = "follower"
    /\ NoLeader
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ role' = [role EXCEPT ![n] = "leader"]
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<seats, enrolled>>

Crash(n) ==
    /\ role[n] = "leader"
    /\ role' = [role EXCEPT ![n] = "crashed"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, seats, enrolled>>

Recover(n) ==
    /\ role[n] = "crashed"
    /\ role' = [role EXCEPT ![n] = "follower"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, seats, enrolled>>

Register(n) ==
    /\ role[n] = "leader"
    /\ enrolled < seats
    /\ enrolled' = enrolled + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<role, term, seats>>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ \E c \in enrolled..MaxSeat : seats' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<role, term, enrolled>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Crash(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Recover(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Register(n)
    \/ Reconfigure

LeaderUniqueness ==
    \A a, b \in Nodes :
        (role[a] = "leader" /\ role[b] = "leader") => a = b

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT LeaderUniqueness
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
A university course-registration service is fronted by several registrar nodes, but only one may act as the leader that commits enrollments to the shared registration ledger. Leadership is granted by election, and a node may become leader only when no other node currently holds leadership. The active leader can crash and fail over: it moves to a crashed state, after which a different node can be elected to take over. A crashed node later recovers to a plain follower. Only the current leader may register a student, and only while the course still has open seats. The course capacity changes at runtime as the registrar adds or removes seats. The hazard is two nodes both believing they are leader and committing conflicting enrollments to the single ledger. The model tracks each node's role, the current leadership term, the seat capacity, and the number enrolled.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At every reachable state at most one registrar node is in the leader role.

A blood-bank inventory tracker is managed by a set of controller nodes, exactly one of which acts as the elected leader responsible for dispatching units to hospitals. A node becomes leader only when no other node is currently leader, and the active leader can crash and fail over to a newly elected replacement. Dispatching a blood unit is irreversible: once a unit leaves the bank it cannot be recalled, so each unit must be dispatched at most once. Only the leader may dispatch, and only while there is refrigerated capacity to stage the outgoing unit. The fridge capacity changes at runtime as shelves are added or taken out of service. The hazard is the same unit being dispatched twice, for instance by a stale leader after failover. The model tracks each node's role, the leadership term, the ordered dispatch log, and the current staging capacity.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od10m0p5t0 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

Trains == {"t1", "t2", "t3"}
NONE   == 99

VARIABLES version, readAt, crossed, crashed
vars == <<version, readAt, crossed, crashed>>

InRange(seq, x) == \E i \in 1..Len(seq) : seq[i] = x

TypeOK ==
    /\ version \in 0..3
    /\ readAt \in [Trains -> 0..3 \cup {NONE}]
    /\ crossed \in Seq(Trains)
    /\ crashed \subseteq Trains

Init ==
    /\ version = 0
    /\ readAt = [t \in Trains |-> NONE]
    /\ crossed = << >>
    /\ crashed = {}

ReadVersion(t) ==
    /\ t \notin crashed
    /\ ~InRange(crossed, t)
    /\ readAt' = [readAt EXCEPT ![t] = version]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, crossed, crashed>>

Commit(t) ==
    /\ t \notin crashed
    /\ readAt[t] = version
    /\ ~InRange(crossed, t)
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ crossed' = Append(crossed, t)
    /\ readAt' = [readAt EXCEPT ![t] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED crashed

Retry(t) ==
    /\ t \notin crashed
    /\ readAt[t] # NONE
    /\ readAt[t] # version
    /\ readAt' = [readAt EXCEPT ![t] = version]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, crossed, crashed>>

Crash(t) ==
    /\ t \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {t}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, readAt, crossed>>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Trains : ReadVersion(t)
    \/ \E t \in Trains : Commit(t)
    \/ \E t \in Trains : Retry(t)
    \/ \E t \in Trains : Crash(t)

CrossOnce ==
    \A i, j \in 1..Len(crossed) :
        crossed[i] = crossed[j] => i = j

NEXT Next
INVARIANT CrossOnce
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
A subway signalling system controls a single critical junction block that trains must cross one at a time. Each train uses optimistic locking: it first reads the block's current version number, then attempts to commit its crossing only if the version has not changed in the meantime; otherwise it must re-read and retry. A successful commit advances the block version by one and records the train as having crossed. Crossing is irreversible in the sense that a given train commits its passage through this junction at most once per run. One train can crash silently at any time, after which it takes no further actions and never crosses. The hazard is a train's crossing being recorded twice, corrupting the occupancy log. The model tracks the block version, each train's last-read version, the ordered crossing log, and the set of crashed trains.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No train appears more than once in the junction crossing log.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od1m0p1t5 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

Controllers == {"c1", "c2", "c3"}
NONE        == 99
MaxV        == 3

VARIABLES version, log, readAt, frozen
vars == <<version, log, readAt, frozen>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ version \in 0..MaxV
    /\ log \in Seq(0..MaxV)
    /\ readAt \in [Controllers -> 0..MaxV \cup {NONE}]
    /\ frozen \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ version = 0
    /\ log = << >>
    /\ readAt = [c \in Controllers |-> NONE]
    /\ frozen = FALSE

Read(c) ==
    /\ version < MaxV
    /\ readAt' = [readAt EXCEPT ![c] = version]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, log, frozen>>

Commit(c) ==
    /\ ~frozen
    /\ readAt[c] = version
    /\ version < MaxV
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ log' = Append(log, version)
    /\ readAt' = [readAt EXCEPT ![c] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED frozen

SetFreeze ==
    /\ frozen' = ~frozen
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, log, readAt>>

AdminCommit(c) ==
    /\ frozen
    /\ version < MaxV
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ log' = Append(log, version)
    /\ readAt' = [readAt EXCEPT ![c] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED frozen

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Read(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Commit(c)
    \/ SetFreeze
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : AdminCommit(c)

NoLostUpdate == \A i \in 1..Len(log) : log[i] = i - 1

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
=============================================================================

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator maintains one shared assignment record, versioned so that concurrent controllers do not clobber each other. Each controller works optimistically: it reads the current version, then commits a new runway assignment only if the version is unchanged, which advances the version by one and appends the assignment to the committed log. A supervisor can temporarily freeze normal commits during a weather event; while frozen, ordinary controllers cannot commit. A privileged admin override lets the supervisor push through an assignment even while frozen, but the override still reads the live version and records its base accordingly, so it never skips a version. The hazard is a lost update: a committed assignment overwriting another that was based on the same version. The model tracks the version counter, the committed log of base versions, each controller's read version, and the frozen flag.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every committed runway assignment recorded a base version equal to the count of assignments already committed, so no assignment overwrites another.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od15m9p3t2 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

Slots    == {"k1", "k2"}
Orders   == {"a1", "a2", "b1", "b2"}
FREE     == "free"
MaxEpoch == 2

VARIABLES assign, epoch, admitted
vars == <<assign, epoch, admitted>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ assign \in [Orders -> Slots \cup {FREE}]
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ admitted \in 0..4

Init ==
    /\ assign = [o \in Orders |-> FREE]
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ admitted = 0

SlotHeld(s) == \E o \in Orders : assign[o] = s

Admit(o, s) ==
    /\ admitted < 4
    /\ assign[o] = FREE
    /\ ~SlotHeld(s)
    /\ assign' = [assign EXCEPT ![o] = s]
    /\ admitted' = admitted + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED epoch

Release(o) ==
    /\ assign[o] # FREE
    /\ assign' = [assign EXCEPT ![o] = FREE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, admitted>>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ assign' = [o \in Orders |-> FREE]
    /\ UNCHANGED admitted

Next ==
    \/ \E o \in Orders, s \in Slots : Admit(o, s)
    \/ \E o \in Orders : Release(o)
    \/ Reconfigure

NoDoubleAllocation ==
    \A o1, o2 \in Orders :
        (assign[o1] # FREE /\ assign[o1] = assign[o2]) => o1 = o2

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleAllocation
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
A stock exchange runs an opening auction in which two independent matching engines draw price-time priority slots from one shared pool. When an order is admitted it is assigned a free slot, meaning a slot not currently held by any other order. Each assignment is stamped implicitly by the current configuration epoch. Periodically the exchange performs an epoch-numbered reconfiguration that bumps the epoch and releases every current slot assignment so priorities can be recomputed. Either engine may admit orders and either may release a slot it assigned. Because two engines share one pool without a central lock, the danger is that both assign the same slot to different orders at the same instant. The model tracks each order's assigned slot, the current epoch, and a running count of admitted orders.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No two distinct orders are ever assigned the same priority slot at the same time.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od19m1p3t0 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

N       == 3
Copies  == {"b1", "b2"}
Patrons == {"p1", "p2"}

VARIABLES token, reservations, crashed, served
vars == <<token, reservations, crashed, served>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ token \in 0..(N-1)
    /\ reservations \subseteq [copy: Copies, patron: Patrons]
    /\ crashed \subseteq 0..(N-1)
    /\ served \in 0..4

Init ==
    /\ token = 0
    /\ reservations = {}
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ served = 0

PassToken ==
    /\ token' = (token + 1) % N
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reservations, crashed, served>>

Reserve(c, p) ==
    /\ token \notin crashed
    /\ served < 4
    /\ \A r \in reservations : r.copy # c
    /\ reservations' = reservations \cup {[copy |-> c, patron |-> p]}
    /\ served' = served + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, crashed>>

Cancel(r) ==
    /\ r \in reservations
    /\ reservations' = reservations \ {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, crashed, served>>

Crash(n) ==
    /\ n \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, reservations, served>>

Next ==
    \/ PassToken
    \/ \E c \in Copies, p \in Patrons : Reserve(c, p)
    \/ \E r \in reservations : Cancel(r)
    \/ \E n \in 0..(N-1) : Crash(n)

NoDoubleReservation ==
    \A r1, r2 \in reservations :
        r1.copy = r2.copy => r1.patron = r2.patron

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleReservation
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
A library book-reservation system is run by a ring of three branch nodes that pass a single token around; only the node currently holding the token may create reservations, which gives exclusive access to the shared reservation pool. When the token holder reserves a copy for a patron, it may only pick a copy that no outstanding reservation already holds. Reservations can later be cancelled, freeing the copy. One branch node can crash silently at any moment, after which it performs no further reservations, but the token still circulates so the other branches keep working. The hazard is the same physical copy being promised to two different patrons at once. The model tracks which node holds the token, the set of outstanding reservations, the set of crashed nodes, and a count of reservations served.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No single library copy is ever held by two different patrons' reservations at the same time.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od9m0p1t1 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

Controllers == {"c1", "c2"}
Ids         == {"m1", "m2", "m3"}
Amounts     == {1, 2}

VARIABLES balance, log, inflight, applied
vars == <<balance, log, inflight, applied>>

RECURSIVE SumSeq(_)
SumSeq(s) == IF Len(s) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE Head(s) + SumSeq(Tail(s))

TypeOK ==
    /\ balance \in 0..6
    /\ log \in Seq(Amounts)
    /\ inflight \subseteq [id: Ids, base: 0..6, amt: Amounts]
    /\ applied \subseteq Ids

Init ==
    /\ balance = 0
    /\ log = << >>
    /\ inflight = {}
    /\ applied = {}

Submit(id, a) ==
    /\ id \notin applied
    /\ \A m \in inflight : m.id # id
    /\ inflight' = inflight \cup {[id |-> id, base |-> balance, amt |-> a]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<balance, log, applied>>

Apply(m) ==
    /\ m \in inflight
    /\ m.base = balance
    /\ m.id \notin applied
    /\ balance' = balance + m.amt
    /\ log' = Append(log, m.amt)
    /\ applied' = applied \cup {m.id}
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<>>

StaleDrop(m) ==
    /\ m \in inflight
    /\ m.base # balance
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<balance, log, applied>>

Withdraw(m) ==
    /\ m \in inflight
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<balance, log, applied>>

Next ==
    \/ \E id \in Ids, a \in Amounts : Submit(id, a)
    \/ \E m \in inflight : Apply(m)
    \/ \E m \in inflight : StaleDrop(m)
    \/ \E m \in inflight : Withdraw(m)

BalanceReflectsLog == balance = SumSeq(log)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
=============================================================================

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT BalanceReflectsLog
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
A power-grid load shedder keeps one shared load-setpoint record, expressed as a running balance of shed megawatts. Several controllers issue adjustments optimistically: each reads the current balance as its base, then sends an adjustment message carrying that base and an amount. Messages travel over a network that can reorder them, so they may arrive in any order. An adjustment is applied only if its base still equals the current balance, in which case the balance increases by the amount and the amount is appended to the committed adjustment log. A message whose base no longer matches is stale and dropped, after which its controller may resubmit. The hazard is a lost update, where an applied adjustment fails to be reflected in the shared balance. The model tracks the balance, the committed adjustment log, the set of in-flight messages, and which adjustment ids have already been applied.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The shared balance always equals the sum of all committed adjustments, so no applied adjustment is ever lost.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od6m8p2t2 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

Zones       == {"z1", "z2", "z3"}
Dispatchers == {"d1", "d2"}
Total       == 3
NONE        == "none"
MaxMoves    == 4

VARIABLES cars, coarse, fine, budget
vars == <<cars, coarse, fine, budget>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ cars \in [Zones -> 0..Total]
    /\ coarse \in Dispatchers \cup {NONE}
    /\ fine \in Dispatchers \cup {NONE}
    /\ budget \in 0..MaxMoves

Init ==
    /\ cars = [z \in Zones |-> IF z = "z1" THEN Total ELSE 0]
    /\ coarse = NONE
    /\ fine = NONE
    /\ budget = MaxMoves

AcquireCoarse(d) ==
    /\ coarse = NONE
    /\ coarse' = d
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cars, fine, budget>>

AcquireFine(d) ==
    /\ coarse = d
    /\ fine = NONE
    /\ fine' = d
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cars, coarse, budget>>

Move(d, from, to) ==
    /\ coarse = d
    /\ fine = d
    /\ from # to
    /\ cars[from] > 0
    /\ budget > 0
    /\ cars' = [cars EXCEPT ![from] = cars[from] - 1, ![to] = cars[to] + 1]
    /\ budget' = budget - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine>>

ReleaseLocks(d) ==
    /\ coarse = d
    /\ coarse' = NONE
    /\ fine' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cars, budget>>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Dispatchers : AcquireCoarse(d)
    \/ \E d \in Dispatchers : AcquireFine(d)

Quorum == 2

    /\ ledger \subseteq Ids
    /\ log \in Seq(Ids)
    /\ pending \subseteq [id: Ids, snap: SUBSET Ids, votes: SUBSET Voters]
    /\ usedIds \subseteq Ids

Init ==
    /\ ledger = {}
    /\ log = << >>
    /\ pending = {}
    /\ usedIds = {}

Propose(id) ==
    /\ id \notin usedIds
    /\ pending' = pending \cup {[id |-> id, snap |-> ledger, votes |-> {}]}
    /\ usedIds' = usedIds \cup {id}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ledger, log>>

CastVote(v, p) ==
    /\ p \in pending
    /\ v \notin p.votes
    /\ pending' = (pending \ {p}) \cup {[id |-> p.id, snap |-> p.snap, votes |-> p.votes \cup {v}]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ledger, log, usedIds>>

Commit(p) ==
    /\ p \in pending
    /\ Cardinality(p.votes) >= Quorum
    /\ p.snap = ledger
    /\ ledger' = ledger \cup {p.id}
    /\ log' = Append(log, p.id)
    /\ pending' = pending \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED usedIds

    /\ p \in pending
    /\ p.snap # ledger
    /\ pending' = pending \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ledger, log, usedIds>>

A pharmacy prescription dispenser keeps one shared dispense ledger, modeled as the set of prescription ids that have been committed. Two independent dispensing terminals share this ledger and each may propose committing a new prescription. A proposal records a snapshot of the ledger at the time it was read. A cluster of pharmacists votes on each proposal, and a proposal commits only when a quorum has voted and its snapshot still matches the current ledger, at which point its id is added to the ledger and appended to the commit log. A proposal whose snapshot is stale is withdrawn. The hazard is a lost update where a committed prescription fails to appear in the ledger, or appears twice. Begin(c) ==
    /\ cstate[c] = "idle"
    /\ cstate' = [cstate EXCEPT ![c] = "collecting"]
    /\ prepared' = [prepared EXCEPT ![c] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<committed, aborts>>

Prepare(c, p) ==
    /\ cstate[c] = "collecting"
    /\ p \notin prepared[c]
    /\ prepared' = [prepared EXCEPT ![c] = prepared[c] \cup {p}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cstate, committed, aborts>>

Commit(c) ==
    /\ cstate[c] = "collecting"
    /\ prepared[c] = Parts
    /\ committed < Cap
    /\ committed' = committed + 1
    /\ cstate' = [cstate EXCEPT ![c] = "committed"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<prepared, aborts>>

Abort(c) ==
    /\ cstate[c] = "collecting"
    /\ aborts < 3
    /\ cstate' = [cstate EXCEPT ![c] = "aborted"]
    /\ aborts' = aborts + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<prepared, committed>>

ResetTxn(c) ==
    /\ cstate[c] \in {"committed", "aborted"}
    /\ cstate' = [cstate EXCEPT ![c] = "idle"]
    /\ prepared' = [prepared EXCEPT ![c] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<committed, aborts>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Coords : Begin(c)
    \/ \E c \in Coords, p \in Parts : Prepare(c, p)
    \/ \E c \in Coords : Commit(c)
    \/ \E c \in Coords : Abort(c)
    \/ \E c \in Coords : ResetTxn(c)

nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm reserves airspace batches through two-phase commit. Two independent mission coordinators share one pool of reservations. To reserve, a coordinator opens a transaction and collects prepare votes from the participant drones; it may commit only once every participant has voted to prepare and the shared reservation count is still below capacity, at which point the reservation count increases. If it cannot gather all votes it aborts. After committing or aborting it resets to idle so a new transaction can begin. The hazard is committing past the reservation capacity, over-subscribing the airspace. The model tracks each coordinator's transaction state, the set of participants that have prepared for each coordinator, the total committed reservation count, and a count of aborted transactions.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The total number of committed airspace reservations never exceeds the fixed capacity.

vars == <<written, version, inflight, authorized>>

    /\ written \in [Slots -> Banks \cup {NONE}]
    /\ version \in 0..MaxV
    /\ inflight \subseteq [bank: Banks, slot: Slots, stamp: 0..MaxV]
    /\ authorized \subseteq Banks

Init ==
    /\ written = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ version = 0
    /\ inflight = {}
    /\ authorized = {}

Authorize(b) ==
    /\ b \notin authorized
    /\ authorized' = authorized \cup {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<written, version, inflight>>

Submit(b, s) ==
    /\ [bank |-> b, slot |-> s, stamp |-> version] \notin inflight
    /\ inflight' = inflight \cup {[bank |-> b, slot |-> s, stamp |-> version]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<written, version, authorized>>

ApplyOK(m) ==
    /\ m \in inflight
    /\ m.stamp = version
    /\ m.bank \in authorized
    /\ written[m.slot] = NONE
    /\ version < MaxV
    /\ written' = [written EXCEPT ![m.slot] = m.bank]
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED authorized

Reject(m) ==
    /\ m \in inflight
    /\ (m.stamp # version \/ m.bank \notin authorized \/ written[m.slot] # NONE)
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<written, version, authorized>>

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Authorize(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks, s \in Slots : Submit(b, s)
    \/ \E m \in inflight : ApplyOK(m)
    \/ \E m \in inflight : Reject(m)

    \A s \in Slots : written[s] # NONE => written[s] \in authorized

nl:
A bank's interbank settlement batch is written slot by slot, guarded by optimistic locking. The batch carries a version number. A bank reads the current version and submits a settlement message stamped with that version for a particular slot; messages travel over a network that can reorder them. A settlement is applied only if its stamp still matches the current version, the target slot is empty, and the submitting bank is authorized; applying it writes the bank into the slot and advances the version. A message that is stale or from an unauthorized bank is rejected. The hazard is an unauthorized bank managing to write a settlement into the batch. The model tracks which bank wrote each slot, the current version, the set of in-flight messages, and the set of authorized banks.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every written settlement slot was written by an authorized bank.

A warehouse robot fleet is coordinated by two independent controllers whose robots share one aisle. To pick from a shelf a robot must be authorized and must hold a hierarchical pair of locks: first the coarse aisle lock, then the fine shelf lock. The hazard is a robot acting on the shared shelf while unauthorized or without properly holding the current locks. The model tracks who holds the coarse aisle lock, who holds the fine shelf lock, the set of robots currently picking, and the set of authorized robots.

    /\ votes \in [Robots -> SUBSET Coords]
    /\ inBay \subseteq Robots
    /\ crashed \subseteq Coords

Init ==
    /\ occupancy = 0
    /\ votes = [r \in Robots |-> {}]
    /\ inBay = {}
    /\ crashed = {}

CastVote(v, r) ==
    /\ v \notin crashed
    /\ r \notin inBay
    /\ v \notin votes[r]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![r] = votes[r] \cup {v}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupancy, inBay, crashed>>

Enter(r) ==
    /\ r \notin inBay
    /\ Cardinality(votes[r]) >= Quorum
    /\ occupancy < Cap
    /\ inBay' = inBay \cup {r}
    /\ occupancy' = occupancy + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, crashed>>

Leave(r) ==
    /\ r \in inBay
    /\ inBay' = inBay \ {r}
    /\ occupancy' = occupancy - 1
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![r] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED crashed

CrashCoord(v) ==
    /\ v \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {v}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupancy, votes, inBay>>

Next ==
    \/ \E v \in Coords, r \in Robots : CastVote(v, r)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Enter(r)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Leave(r)
    \/ \E v \in Coords : CrashCoord(v)

Before a robot may enter the bay, a cluster of dispatch coordinators votes on its request, and the robot enters only once a quorum of coordinators approves and the bay is not already full. Entering fills one bay spot; leaving frees it. One coordinator can crash silently and then casts no more votes, though the remaining coordinators can still form a quorum. The hazard is more robots entering the bay than it can physically hold. The model tracks the current bay occupancy, the votes gathered for each robot, the set of robots currently in the bay, and the set of crashed coordinators.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od14m9p4t3 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

Drones   == {"g1", "g2", "g3"}
Cap      == 2
MaxEpoch == 2

VARIABLES holders, grantEpoch, epoch, inflight
vars == <<holders, grantEpoch, epoch, inflight>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ holders \subseteq Drones
    /\ grantEpoch \in [Drones -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ inflight \subseteq [drone: Drones, stamp: 0..MaxEpoch]

Init ==
    /\ holders = {}
    /\ grantEpoch = [d \in Drones |-> 0]
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ inflight = {}

Request(d) ==
    /\ d \notin holders
    /\ \A m \in inflight : m.drone # d
    /\ inflight' = inflight \cup {[drone |-> d, stamp |-> epoch]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holders, grantEpoch, epoch>>

Grant(m) ==
    /\ m \in inflight
    /\ m.stamp = epoch
    /\ m.drone \notin holders
    /\ Cardinality(holders) < Cap
    /\ holders' = holders \cup {m.drone}
    /\ grantEpoch' = [grantEpoch EXCEPT ![m.drone] = epoch]
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED epoch

DropStale(m) ==
    /\ m \in inflight
    /\ m.stamp # epoch
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holders, grantEpoch, epoch>>

Release(d) ==
    /\ d \in holders
    /\ holders' = holders \ {d}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<grantEpoch, epoch, inflight>>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ holders' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<grantEpoch, inflight>>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Request(d)
    \/ \E m \in inflight : Grant(m)
    \/ \E m \in inflight : DropStale(m)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Release(d)
    \/ Reconfigure

CapacityAndFreshness ==
    /\ Cardinality(holders) <= Cap
    /\ \A d \in holders : grantEpoch[d] = epoch

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapacityAndFreshness
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm reserves airspace cells up to a fixed capacity, with reservations tagged by a configuration epoch. A drone first requests a reservation, stamping the request with the current epoch; requests may be slow, sitting in flight while the swarm proceeds. A request is granted only if its stamp still matches the current epoch and the swarm is below capacity, adding the drone to the current holders stamped with the epoch. A slow request whose stamp has fallen behind the epoch is dropped, since the drone is not failed but simply late. A drone may release its reservation. Periodically an epoch-numbered reconfiguration bumps the epoch and clears all current holders. The hazard is reserving beyond capacity or a stale holder surviving a reconfiguration. The model tracks the set of current holders, each holder's granting epoch, the current epoch, and the set of in-flight requests.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of current airspace holders never exceeds capacity and every holder was granted in the current epoch.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od18m8p3t5 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

Controllers == {"ct1", "ct2"}
Rooms       == {"rm1", "rm2"}
Occupants   == {"o1", "o2"}
NONE        == "none"

VARIABLES grants, coarse, fine, overrides
vars == <<grants, coarse, fine, overrides>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ grants \subseteq [room: Rooms, occ: Occupants]
    /\ coarse \in Controllers \cup {NONE}
    /\ fine \in Controllers \cup {NONE}
    /\ overrides \in 0..3

Init ==
    /\ grants = {}
    /\ coarse = NONE
    /\ fine = NONE
    /\ overrides = 0

RoomFree(rm) == \A g \in grants : g.room # rm
OccFree(o)   == \A g \in grants : g.occ # o

AcquireCoarse(c) ==
    /\ coarse = NONE
    /\ coarse' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<grants, fine, overrides>>

AcquireFine(c) ==
    /\ coarse = c
    /\ fine = NONE
    /\ fine' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<grants, coarse, overrides>>

Grant(c, rm, o) ==
    /\ coarse = c
    /\ fine = c
    /\ RoomFree(rm)
    /\ OccFree(o)
    /\ grants' = grants \cup {[room |-> rm, occ |-> o]}
    /\ coarse' = NONE
    /\ fine' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED overrides

Vacate(g) ==
    /\ g \in grants
    /\ grants' = grants \ {g}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, overrides>>

AdminGrant(rm, o) ==
    /\ overrides < 3
    /\ RoomFree(rm)
    /\ OccFree(o)
    /\ grants' = grants \cup {[room |-> rm, occ |-> o]}
    /\ overrides' = overrides + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : AcquireCoarse(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : AcquireFine(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, rm \in Rooms, o \in Occupants : Grant(c, rm, o)
    \/ \E g \in grants : Vacate(g)
    \/ \E rm \in Rooms, o \in Occupants : AdminGrant(rm, o)

RoomSingleOccupant ==
    \A g1, g2 \in grants :
        g1.room = g2.room => g1.occ = g2.occ

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT RoomSingleOccupant
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
A smart-home door-lock network assigns rooms to occupants under hierarchical locking. To grant a room to an occupant a controller must take the coarse house lock first and then the fine room lock, and may grant a room only if that room currently backs no other grant and the occupant holds no other room. A grant can later be vacated. A privileged home administrator can override the locking protocol and grant a free room directly, without holding the house and room locks, but still only when the room is unoccupied. The hazard is the same room being granted to two different occupants at once. The model tracks the set of active room grants, who holds the coarse house lock, who holds the fine room lock, and the number of admin overrides used.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No single room is ever granted to two different occupants at the same time.
